prompt:
Subdivide sheet1 (the recruitment job-listings dataset) into ever-finer
job posting buckets.

  Step 4: subdivide each leaf along "Education Requirement".

until no further meaningful subdivision is possible. For each
leaf, report "Salary Range" statistics
(count, mean, median, std).
